notes.title: Greenjamin skates into a brand-new sequel, SKATOR GATOR 3D!
notes.content:
[h3]Weathered Sweater is proud to announce Greenjamin Gator's return in [b]SKATOR GATOR 3D[/b], the brand-new sequel to Skator Gator![/h3]

After taking the fight to the robo-capitalists in Rat City, our skating gator has new challenges to tackle across unique 3D locales — from sunset-bathed swamps to moonlit marshes.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XHk0L5v.png[/img]

The lane-based platforming of the original game returns with familiar powerups influencing your gameplay in new ways, and the 3D platforming areas will have you exploring every nook and cranny for all sorts of collectables.

[h3]This adventure in the third dimension is one you don't want to miss![/h3]
[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1996470/Skator_Gator_3D/][b]Wishlist the game now on Steam![/b][/url][/h3]
